main_text.head: AD CAP. XVII.
main_text.p: Pag. 173. lin. 9, Ω᾽ξύλοι μάχαι- {*}σεσιν. ] Verè, quia nos per illud μάχαιρις. Atque ita σεβασμιώτατον καὶ τίμιον, adorandum & venerabile, Imperator appellat novellâ quintâ. Eaque caufsâ vetitum, in lapidibus fculpi, quæ in folo. Lex extat in Codice Justinianæo : & apud Paullum Diaconum sic Tiberius : Crucem Domini quâ frontem nostram & pectora munire debemus, eam sub pedibus concul-camus ? Tale & Synodus habita in Trullo, can. lxxxiii. Quamquam autem è pavimentis templorum remota, non etiam è tectis. Fulfit jam olim ibi, clarum certumque symbolum Christiani cultus. Nicephorus Gregoras libro ix. in descriptione tempestatis quæ Constantinopoli : Τηνικαῦτα μὲν τοι πεπλώκασι καὶ πόλει
{*} Mark of reference at the left margin of the line "pidibus" (asterisk-like mark).

page.notes: The Greek in the text is printed in a larger, italic-like type and is transcribed as best read; the first Greek words of line 9 and the final Greek words are doubtful. The asterisk-like mark at the left of "pidibus" is a reference mark. The top right of the page carries a faint printed mark. Roman numerals "XVII." in the heading is printed "XVII" with a decorative x.
